title: rare-event-mcmc-qec: rare-event Markov chain Monte Carlo for logical error statistics of quantum codes
description: Code, cluster job scripts, simulation outputs, and reference estimates for the paper Fast and accurate rare-event simulation by Markov chain Monte Carlo for general quantum codes by Junichi Haruna and Kotaro Murakami. The repository contains the MCMC sampler kernels studied in the paper (the one-bit-flip baseline and the proposed kernel with locally balanced flips and a weight-preserving cluster exchange), the MCMC-independent reference estimators, the PBS job scripts that produced every simulation output, those outputs as CSV, and the scripts that regenerate every table and figure of the paper from them (python reproduce.py --check).
